sources.label: Freeze authority freezes a wallet's ZLUSD account on October 30 2026
Permanent delegate burns 13,000 ZLUSD from a holder account on October 1 2026
Anchorage Digital Bank covered stablecoin terms: transfer restrictions and freeze powers

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Verified on Solana mainnet at finalized slot 464063902 (2026-11-01 10:47:47 UTC). ZLUSD has one deployment, the Token-2022 mint 7NNkMtGACBbwJdMRYD2KchTKm2xBwnsb4bT7YSfRUWZ4 (6 decimals, supply 137,650.11 ZLUSD), which holds 100% of supply. Its freeze authority FiV6goxf5fYfw9y7XwuG8bVAG6bqTb1sR1rrLomjkXa3 is a system-owned key account that signed freezeAccount on this mint five times between June 18 and October 30 2026, each time creating and freezing the token account of a specific wallet; no thaw has been signed. Its permanent delegate C2QJ4HKLWzWRNprAmKoyd6YqXouVHFZuLKujdqtF4ZDt, which is also the mint authority, is a system-owned key account that signed all nine burnChecked instructions on holder token accounts without the owners' signatures (20,612 ZLUSD in total, including 13,000 from one account on October 1 2026), so it can burn or move any holder's balance. The mint also carries a pausable extension (authority fEnXbNWPAkmhVK1nL1H2sQVdkF3y4eh8CuqnCsnDXqx, paused=false) and a transfer-hook extension whose authority 8N2NFYQ5VMaoDGMAcUbfzdeJqvok6LQs2E9BxDK6mMAE can set a hook program; none is set, and the default account state is initialized. The same authority set controls the Anchorage-issued USDPT and USDGO mints. Anchorage Digital Bank's covered stablecoin terms state that it may freeze, block, seize or otherwise restrict covered stablecoins held by clients and non-clients alike. This is a direct Yes control on the only material deployment. There is no parent (variantOf and mintAuthority.inheritedFrom are absent), and reserves are not the basis of this verdict.
